Home.heroSubtitle: Personalised 1-to-1 language tutoring in English, French, Italian and German — tailored to your goals, level and learning style.
Home.heroTagline: Our philosophy: Prima parla, poi impara!
Home.step1Title: 1. Choose a lesson or a package
Home.step1Body: A single 60 minute lesson, or a discounted package of 4 or 8 lessons.
Home.step2Body: Pick a free date and time from the calendar, shown automatically in your timezone.
Home.step3Body: Secure card payment. You'll get an email confirmation and an automatic invoice.
Home.languagesBody:
At Carray Tutoring, languages are taught as more than a collection of grammar rules and vocabulary. We create personalised learning experiences designed to help students communicate with confidence, naturally and effectively.

Our lessons combine language development with the culture, traditions, history and everyday realities that bring a language to life. Whether the goal is academic success, professional communication, travel, university or personal growth, every lesson is tailored to the individual learner.

With over five years of tutoring experience and a truly international perspective, Carray Tutoring works with learners of different ages, backgrounds and abilities. The philosophy is simple: speak first, learn through communication, and build confidence along the way.
Home.aboutBody: Hi, I'm Matthieu — the person you'll actually be working with. Over the past five years I've taught learners of all ages and levels, always with the same starting point: speak first, and let confidence grow through real communication rather than memorised rules. I bring a genuinely international perspective to every lesson, tailoring the pace and material to what you actually need — whether that's exam prep, a smoother professional email, or just enjoying your next trip a little more.

starter.name: Carray Starter
starter.what: Lessons: 1 individual lesson per week (45 min)
starter.how: Materials included (shared whiteboard), homework included (grammar, writing, presentations, dialogues — always speaking-focused, never "school-style")
starter.condition: Only for new students of the academy
starter.whyLevel: This is the first step, designed for those who've never tried a structured program before — a light pace (1x/week) to get started without pressure, understand the method, and see real first results within a month. It's the natural entry point into the Carray ecosystem, reserved for new students to make that first step even more accessible.

progress.name: Carray Progress
progress.what: Lessons: 2 individual lessons per week (45 min)
progress.how: Materials included and updated to your personalised plan, speaking-focused homework, mid-program check-in
progress.whyLevel: Once you've had your first taste, the pace doubles (2x/week) and the timeline extends to 8 weeks — enough time to build real fluency, not just familiarity. It's the natural next step after Starter, for those ready to see real, measurable change.

fluency.name: Carray Fluency
fluency.what: Lessons: 2 individual lessons per week (45 min)
fluency.how: Full materials for the entire program, monthly plan review, milestones at weeks 4/8/12, final level report
fluency.whyLevel: This is the final milestone of the Carray program — same pace as Progress, extended to 12 weeks for those with an important goal (university, work, relocation) who want to reach real fluency. Those who reach this level have already validated the method in earlier stages.
fluency.extra: Includes support toward earning an official certification (Cambridge English, IELTS, TOEFL)
fluency.extraNote: Language certifications are official qualifications that attest to your level of a foreign language according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), from A1 to C2.

RefundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
RefundPolicy.subtitle: When a purchase can be refunded, and how to request it.
RefundPolicy.eligibilityBody: Single sessions, 4- and 8-lesson packages, and Carray structured programs (Starter, Progress, Fluency) can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase, provided no session from that purchase has been used yet.
RefundPolicy.usedHeading: Once a session has been used
RefundPolicy.usedBody: As soon as one session from a purchase has taken place, that purchase — and any remaining credits or sessions within it — is no longer eligible for a refund. This applies even if you are still within the 14-day window.
RefundPolicy.distinctionHeading: How this differs from other policies
RefundPolicy.distinctionBody:
This Refund Policy is separate from two other policies on this site:

• The statutory right of withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht) under EU/German consumer law, described on our Right of Withdrawal page, which applies independently of and takes precedence over this policy.
• Our 12-hour cancellation and rescheduling policy for sessions you have already booked, which is unaffected by this Refund Policy and continues to apply as described in your booking confirmation.
RefundPolicy.requestBody: To request a refund, email us at info@carraytutoring.com with your booking or order reference number. We'll confirm your eligibility and process approved refunds to your original payment method.

CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.subtitle: What cookies and similar technologies we use, and why.
CookiePolicy.whatAreCookiesBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They can be used to remember your preferences, keep you logged in, or track your activity across sites.
CookiePolicy.analyticsBody: We use Plausible Analytics to understand how visitors use this site. Plausible is a cookieless analytics tool: it does not use cookies, does not collect personal data, and does not track individuals across websites or devices. Because no cookies or tracking identifiers are set, no consent is required for this under the GDPR or the German TTDSG.
CookiePolicy.functionalBody:
A small number of cookies are required for the site to function correctly. These do not require consent under GDPR/TTDSG because they are essential to providing the service you requested.

• Language preference — remembers which of our 4 site languages you're browsing in.
• Admin session — used only by the site administrator to stay logged in to the booking-management panel; not set for regular visitors.
CookiePolicy.paymentBody: When you make a purchase, you are redirected to Stripe's secure hosted checkout page to enter your payment details. Stripe may set its own cookies on its own domain as part of that process — this is governed by Stripe's own privacy and cookie policies, which you can review at stripe.com/privacy.
CookiePolicy.questionsBody: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at info@carraytutoring.com.
CookiePolicy.noticeBody: We use cookie-free analytics and a couple of strictly necessary cookies to run this site.
